driverUnused: No device needs the driver “{{driver}}” any more. Remove it too?
title: Stage
explain: Every device of the band and where it is connected. At the top click, backing track and announcements - built in, only the playing device can be chosen. Below amp, mixer, looper and the like, each with its type and the tablet it hangs on.

midi.title: {{device}}: buttons
midi.intro: Each button triggers an action - like a pedal: momentary, latching or timed. Show and sections only when the tablet the controller is plugged into may control the show.
midi.press: Press the button on the controller now …
midi.learnHere: Learning only works on the tablet the controller is plugged into - enter it by hand here.
midi.onlyValueInfo: For controllers that send several buttons over the same CC with different values. Off: any value above 0 presses, 0 releases.
midi.taken: This button is already mapped (“{{mapping}}”) - saving replaces it.

osc.intro: Each button triggers an action - like a pedal: momentary, latching or timed. Run by the device that controls the show.
osc.onlyValueInfo: For controllers that send several buttons over the same address with different values (/scene 1, /scene 2). Off: a value above 0 presses, 0 releases.

wiz.name: Name
wiz.whichType: What kind of device is it?
wiz.waitsSelf: · waiting for that device to register itself
wiz.controllerCheck: To check: in the device's ⋯ “Map buttons” - a button on the controller is recognised there right away.
wiz.runsOnServer: Runs on the Stage server - check it there.
wiz.runsElsewhere: Runs on another device - check it there.
wiz.noConnection: No connection set yet - finish step 3 first to test here.
wiz.title: Set up a device

stage.title: Paths
stage.explain: Every physical path from a device to the ear - its own sound over speaker, headphones or USB, and every device a tablet drives - has exactly one latency correction. ● measured, ◐ by hand, ○ missing. Align it where the path matters most (the click at the drums).
stage.noPaths: No paths yet - this device plays nothing.
stage.viewOnly: Without a profile view only - choose who you are first.

map.title: Stage map
map.explain: All of the band's devices and equipment with their ports and cables, per setup. A cable shows what is patched onto it (click, track, Kemper …). A path runs from the tablet to whoever hears it. Nothing plays by the map yet - that comes as its own step.
map.deleteSetupConfirm: Delete setup “{{name}}” with all its cables?
map.hint: Tap a device or a cable.
map.connecting: Connecting from {{port}} - tap a highlighted device.
map.name: Name
map.nothingOnCable: No signal - nothing is routed here.
map.pruneConfirm: Afterwards {{links}} cables and {{points}} matrix points no longer fit - they will be removed.
map.decidesBuiltIn: Who plays click, track and announcements is set in the stage map above - in each tablet's matrix (default: every device on its speaker).
map.midiTitle: MIDI port at the other end

ports.title: Ports: {{name}}
ports.intro: One row per group of inputs or outputs - as on the device. Groups of the same name count on (input 1-10 combo, 11-20 XLR).
ports.name: Name
ports.partsHint: What runs over this socket - one part per protocol and direction (e.g. "Audio out" with 4 channels). Without a count, whatever the device at the other end has applies.

wiring.title: Wiring ({{n}} cables)
wiring.allGood: No problems: every channel has at most one cable, mono and stereo fit.
wiring.monoOfStereo: {{where}}: stereo socket used for one channel only
wiring.none: No cables in this setup yet.

lead.title: Lead on Play
lead.explain: This long after Play is pressed a new song (with its count-in) starts on every device at once. Each device needs the time for the Play to arrive plus its audio output's delay. With too short a lead, click and announcement come late on that device at the start. Every device measures at each Play what it would have needed - it shows here when that was more.
lead.label: Lead
lead.tooShort: {{name}} last needed {{ms}} ms - raise the lead to at least {{suggest}} ms.
lead.notMeasured: Not measured yet - every device checks at the next Play.

hostPlugins.title: Server plugins on this host
hostPlugins.unknown: This Stage-Server doesn't report yet what it can run (older version).
hostPlugins.cannot: can't run on this host - needs {{needs}}
